description:
Arc 73 builds slice 2b -- the READER half of the black box (the longitudinal accountability backstop), COMPLETING the capture-then-read loop. Design input: docs/self-correction-doctrine-DRAFT.md (section 6 the accountability moves / the longitudinal loop + the Resolved section re-verify gate). Builds on Arc 71 (the decision-register RECORD it reads) + Arc 70/72 (the FLAG + GUIDE).

THE MECHANISM (doctrine section 6 + Resolved): at complaint-time -- when the PRINCIPAL expresses regret or blame about a past decided call -- pull the SPECIFIC logged decision-register entry and run the RE-VERIFY GATE: does the logged entry support the callback? Two outcomes: (a) SUPPORTED (the entry contains the warning now biting) -> surface honestly, forward-accountability (you chose X; here is the tradeoff you accepted; the counter-hypothesis we logged is what is now happening; what now); (b) NOT SUPPORTED / no entry -> the callback does NOT fire, the agent OWNS THE GAP (I did not flag this clearly enough). The gate reduces to one question: does the logged entry support the callback? Anti-gaslighting BOTH directions -- catches the user hindsight self-serving edit AND the agent false I-told-you-so.

IN SCOPE: (1) a complaint-callback + re-verify-gate module -- the complaint trigger + over-fire guard, the entry lookup (reads the Arc-71 register by DR-ID/context, no write-back), the re-verify gate (does-the-entry-support-the-callback with the two outcomes), and the delivery (forward-accountability, guilt-lane, I-fucked-up-first honest + door-not-blanket per section 6; reuse the classifier section-4 diagnostic tree). (2) a both-directions seed corpus of entry+complaint fixture PAIRS -- callback-SHOULD-fire (entry contains the warning, complaint matches) vs callback-must-NOT-fire (no entry / entry lacks the warning / complaint is a different thing -> own the gap); anti-gaslighting controls run BOTH ways. (3) wire it into the loop reading the Arc-71 decision-register schema (WARNING + COUNTER-HYPOTHESIS are what the gate checks; DR-ID is the pull-address).

OUT OF SCOPE (named follow-on): dose-calibration off the user track record ships a NEUTRAL-DEFAULT v1 only -- the per-user-history tuning ACCRETES (we have no track record yet; the doctrine says calibrate off the real track record NOT a stereotype, so faking a dose model now would violate the doctrine); the consumer-tier variant (its own artifact); the meta-trigger counter (slice 4); the broader checkpoint rollout (slice 4).

DEFINITION OF DONE -- mechanical: the reader module composes into the target role files; the callback fires on a complaint about a logged decision and the re-verify gate runs (EXERCISED not asserted -- a real complaint -> pull entry -> gate verdict, both outcomes demonstrated live); the both-directions corpus passes at a stated floor (callback-supported surfaces honestly AND callback-unsupported owns-the-gap -- anti-gaslighting BOTH ways); FULL suite green incl ALL THREE existing corpora (dilemma 19 + decision-register 18 + decision-surface 19 -- regression, the reader touches the loop); NOMOS CONFORMANT; Author=PRINCIPAL + seat trailer. Judgment (honest): the record-vs-callback gate is crisp + buildable from fixtures; the genuinely-biting + dose judgment ACCRETES from real use; do NOT fake a dose model from a stereotype; the loop closes STRUCTURALLY (record exists + gate checks it) but calibration accretes; success = the agent did not lie. Same honest stance as slices 1/2a/3.

TEAM: standard POLYBIUS+PLINY, full gauntlet, substrate-component design (new module + corpus; no CHIRON/HAMILTON). This COMPLETES the doctrine core (slices 1+2a+2b+3); only slice 4 (rollout + meta-trigger) remains.
